page_title: MAR 3-2 LYO | Marseille v Lyon 02/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Jerome Brisard shows a yellow card to Derek Cornelius (Marseille) for his blatant foul.

90+4' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Lucas Perri was alert and the score remains the same.
90+2' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Lucas Perri is alert and denies him.
90+2' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) receives a yellow card.
90+2' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) attempts to delay the restart of play. The referee doesn't like it.
90+1' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) takes the corner with a short pass.
90+1' A cross from Amine Gouiri (Marseille) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball goes out for a corner. Marseille can continue in their attacking effort.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ulisses Garcia (Marseille) comes onto the pitch so that Mason Greenwood can be given a rest.
89' Great teamplay by Lyon as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
86' Here is a change. Nemanja Matic is going off and Paulo Fonseca gives the last tactical orders to Thiago Almada (Lyon).
86' A substitution has been made. Jordan Veretout goes off and Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) comes on.

85' 3 - 2 Luis Henrique (Marseille) meets a perfect cross from Pol Lirola deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike into the top right corner. It's 3:2.
84' A cross by Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
84' Lucas Perri pulls off a great save to deny Amine Gouiri (Marseille), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
82' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) has tested the patience of referee Jerome Brisard and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

82' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Lucas Perri guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
81' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) will deliver the corner kick.

81' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. Marseille have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
81' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went way over the bar.
80' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
80' Substitution. Pol Lirola (Marseille) replaces Quentin Merlin.
79' Paulo Fonseca has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) replacing Alexandre Lacazette.
79' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

78' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Lucas Perri is alert and denies him with a nice save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Marseille.
78' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
78' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
76' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
74' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) makes a strong challenge and Jerome Brisard blows for a foul.
72' 2 - 2 GOAL! That’s a perfect strike from the spot by Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) into the top right hand corner, giving goalkeeper Geronimo Rulli no chance!
71' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
70' The Lyon players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
70' Referee Jerome Brisard makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Lyon. Let’s see what happens!
68' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
68' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
68' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
67' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Lyon will take a corner.
66' Jerome Brisard blows the whistle, Valentin Rongier (Marseille) is penalised for a foul.
64' 2 - 1 GOAL! Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) scores with a header from close range after Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg headed a pin-point lofted cross into his path. It's 2:1.

64' A big opportunity is wasted by Michael Murillo (Marseille), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the bottom left corner. Unfortunately for him, Lucas Perri pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort.
61' Roberto De Zerbi appears to have said too much and referee Jerome Brisard comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
61' 1 - 1 Goal! Mason Greenwood (Marseille) scores after an assist by Amine Gouiri that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 1:1.
60' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

60' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the roof of the net, but Geronimo Rulli was alert and the score remains the same. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lyon are going to take it.
58' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Bilal Nadir.
58' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball into the stands. Nice run, but poor finish!
56' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Corentin Tolisso (Lyon), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.

55' A sweet pass finds Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball low towards the middle of the goal. Geronimo Rulli is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. Rayan Cherki (Lyon) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
53' 0 - 1 Goal! Rayan Cherki manages to prod the ball to Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
50' Marseille can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
50' The corner is swung in but Marseille can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
49' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Marseille are awarded a corner kick.
48' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.

47' Bilal Nadir (Marseille) accelerated away from the defence and took his shot early from the edge of the box. The ball flew low towards the middle of the goal, but Lucas Perri made a superb athletic save to deny him.
46' Derek Cornelius (Marseille) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
44' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) is flagged for offside.

43' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
43' The free kick will be taken by Rayan Cherki (Lyon).
42' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Michael Murillo (Marseille) was quite harsh and Jerome Brisard didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
41' The possession of the ball – 67:33.
40' Luis Henrique (Marseille) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jerome Brisard has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
36' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
34' The Marseille players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
32' Clinton Mata (Lyon) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
30' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle and it's Mason Greenwood (Marseille) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
27' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.

26' He should have scored! Bilal Nadir (Marseille) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the bottom left corner is pretty weak and Lucas Perri makes an easy save.
24' Michael Murillo (Marseille) comes close to scoring. He peels away from his marker and gets on the end of a cross from Quentin Merlin, but he hits a shot just wide of the right post.

22' What an opportunity! Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
21' It seemed like Rayan Cherki (Lyon) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
21' Derek Cornelius (Marseille) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Lyon have a free kick.
20' A clumsy foul by Derek Cornelius (Marseille) and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle.
18' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Quentin Merlin (Marseille). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
18' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Luis Henrique (Marseille), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Marseille get a corner.
14' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) goes for goal, but slices it wide of the target.
11' Jerome Brisard couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Michael Murillo (Marseille) and blew his whistle.
11' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
9' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jerome Brisard blows for a foul.
8' Handball by Ernest Nuamah (Lyon).
7' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Jerome Brisard stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
3' Neat passing move from Lyon in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Lyon will take the kick-off.
Jerome Brisard is introduced as the referee for today's match.
